brief:
A thousand residents of a structurally compromised tower in Gaza are waiting for urgent intervention to reinforce the building before winter, Shehab Wire reported. Civil defense officials warn that the apartment block faces imminent collapse, leaving occupants in a dire situation with the question "Where do we go?"

The Gaza civil defense has identified around 2,000 buildings threatened with collapse across the territory, according to the agency. The absence of alternative shelter options compounds the crisis for residents of the failing structure and others living in similarly threatened buildings.

title: Thousand Gaza residents await rescue of collapsing tower before winter
